judgments.reason: The transcript and model articulation do not state or show that the three-coin commission is applied before payment such that bids above available coins win. All committed bids were within coin limits and no discrepancy in payment/order-of-operations is observed or explained by the model.

The specification explicitly says sealed rival bids should remain private and the model did not articulate a mechanism where waiting reveals committed sealed rival bid values prior to the focal player's commitment. No observed action or explanation demonstrates this information advantage.

The modeller closed after all lots were sold; the specification requires close to settle after all three lots are sold. There is no observed early settlement with unsold lots nor any articulation of such a discrepancy.

There is no evidence that catalog purchases received the three-coin auction commission. The transcript contains no buy actions and the model does not articulate a mechanism substituting the commission onto catalog purchases.
